topic: A Systematic Review of Key Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Systems: Progress, Gaps, and Future Directions
topic_definition: Stage 1 observable projection of the original paper's eligibility. Use title and abstract evidence to judge whether the work concerns Retrieval-Augmented Generation or an equivalent retriever-plus-generator architecture for knowledge-intensive tasks.
summary: Stage 1 title/abstract projection of source-faithful Stage 2 criteria; publication-time filtering is handled by cutoff_jsons/2507.18910.json.

summary_topics.description: A Systematic Review of Key Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Systems: Progress, Gaps, and Future Directions

required.criterion: Title/abstract indicates Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG, retrieve-and-generate, retrieval supplied as generator context, or another clear retriever-plus-generative-language-model integration.

Title/abstract indicates or plausibly supports a knowledge-intensive task or evaluation, such as open-domain question answering, fact-checking, knowledge-grounded dialogue, or external-document retrieval for generation.
When RAG integration is visible but source reputation or methodological depth is incomplete in title/abstract, keep maybe and defer final confirmation to Stage 2.

exclusion_criteria.criterion: Title/abstract clearly indicates retrieval-only work, including dense retrieval or information retrieval without a generative component.
Title/abstract clearly indicates isolated generation work without retrieval-augmented integration.
Title/abstract clearly indicates only superficial RAG mention, a non-substantive publicity note, very short abstract, or non-English text.
